props.label: Main
props.html:
Home/Services

Landscaping services across the Blue Mountains

Design and construction, retaining walls, paving, turf, tree work, maintenance, mulching and more — one local team for the whole Mountains.

Landscape Design & Construction

Full design-and-build landscaping for Blue Mountains homes — we plan it, we build it, and you get one accountable local team from first sketch to final planting.

Learn more

Soft Landscaping

Garden beds, planting and green space designed for the Mountains climate — plants that actually survive the cold snaps and suit your block.

Learn more

Hard Landscaping

The built structure of your garden — paths, patios, steps and stonework — engineered for Mountains slope and weather.

Learn more

Retaining Walls

Timber, block and stone retaining walls engineered for the sloping sites that make up so much of the Blue Mountains.

Learn more

Paving, Pavers & Stone

Paving, pavers, pebble and natural stone — driveways, courtyards and feature paths laid on solid bases so they stay put.

Learn more

Turf & Artificial Grass

New turf or premium artificial grass — a green, usable lawn that copes with Mountains shade, frost and traffic.

Learn more

Tree Services

Tree removal, lopping, pruning and trimming across the Blue Mountains — done safely by careful, insured operators.

Learn more

Garden Maintenance

Regular or one-off garden maintenance — pruning, hedge trimming and seasonal tidy-ups that keep your garden looking its best.

Learn more

Lawn Mowing & Care

One-off or ongoing lawn mowing, edging and care — a tidy, healthy lawn without the weekend work.

Learn more

Gutter Cleaning

Leaf and debris clearing to protect your home — especially important up here before storm and bushfire season.

Learn more

Mulching & Weeding

Fresh mulch, weed removal and weed control that keeps your garden beds healthy, tidy and low-maintenance.

Learn more
